findings.title: A failed compressed or mismatched attempt permanently poisons the required-session byte aggregate
findings.contract: The runtime lifecycle contract defines byte totals over the required requests' current attempts and excludes bytes from previous failed attempts.

observed.firstAttempt: Compressed room response reached EOF with four bytes, then a synthetic parse failure triggered retry attempt 2.
observed.currentAttempts: Room retry, resident, and fixture each returned explicit identity encoding, Content-Length 4, exactly four bytes, and parsed successfully.

findings.cause: aggregateInvalid is set for any compressed or trusted-length-mismatched read and remains session-wide. The retry path replaces attemptProgress[index] but does not reset or derive aggregateInvalid from current attempts. currentAggregate checks the sticky flag before accepting all-known current entries.
findings.impact: No false determinate progress was observed. A transient invalid representation leaves progress indeterminate for the remainder of an otherwise successful load, under-reporting progress and violating the current-attempt contract.
findings.coverageGap: The parameterized untrusted-header test successfully parses its first untrusted response, so that response remains the current attempt. The parse-failure retry test uses a valid identity EOF, so it never sets aggregateInvalid and does not check whether a valid retry restores determinate progress.
findings.recommendation: Make invalid representation state attempt-scoped or derive it from current required attempts, and add a regression for invalid bytes followed by a successful identity retry.

evidenceGaps.title: Independent full production build could not be completed in the audit assembly
evidenceGaps.detail: The default build exited 1 before compilation because Turbopack rejected the audit-only node_modules junction for pointing outside its filesystem root. A webpack build started but was stopped before completion at Parent's request; it has no compiler result. The maker build log and source-bound identity report a successful production build.

evidenceGaps.title: Production-browser results do not directly exercise the new R5 regressions
evidenceGaps.detail: The maker's three Chromium cases cover held requests and indeterminate ARIA, pause recovery/runtime recreation, and the transfer watchdog. They do not test retry aggregate recovery, optional-map rollback, or WorldRuntime greeting timer replacement. No separate success screenshots were captured. Independent browser rerun was not performed because the audit build did not complete.

evidenceGaps.title: Maker red-run shell invocation lines are not preserved
evidenceGaps.detail: Raw red logs record the failing Vitest files and cases, but validation-results.json explicitly says the shell invocation line was not persisted. The maker report also says exact runner details are preserved, which overstates the available command evidence.

evidenceGaps.title: External provider, deployment, physical-device, and assistive-technology acceptance
evidenceGaps.detail: These scopes were explicitly excluded from FINISH-08 and are not claimed by this local audit.

otherSourceReview.assessment: No additional material source-contract defect was found in the texture-copy isolation/rollback or WorldRuntime timer paths after reviewing implementation, consumers, negative paths, and focused unit evidence.
